vetSays.line: 🛡️ Scarlett, Maureen, DeShawn and Daniyar met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Scarlett, Maureen, DeShawn, Daniyar are hurt.
🛡️ Maureen, DeShawn and Tariq met them at the door — 3 put down. Maureen, DeShawn, Tariq are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Scarlett, Maureen, DeShawn and Regina met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Maureen, DeShawn, Regina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Regina just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down Don't-Look... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down Don't-Look... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Yara, Ursula and Maya met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Yara, Ursula, Maya are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniyar just put down Don't-Look... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maureen just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Quinn just put down Don't-Look... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Asher, Delfina, Quinn and Josue met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Asher, Delfina, Quinn, Josue are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Big Big falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big Big!
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Quinn taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📖 Quinn is showing Daniyar the Ground Elder — leaf, stem, smell.
Maureen showed Yara the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Delfina just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Josue just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

Quinn is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.

🛡️ Asher, Delfina, Quinn and Josue met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Delfina is hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
